answer: Sybils must fund each fake identity separately, so costs volume linearly with clone count. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity with periodic liveness proofs: each agent locks collateral, and every epoch it must submit a fresh signed pulse tied to its registered key. Cheap throwaway accounts fail the liveness check, like footprints erased by a shifting dune. A light zephyr of random peer challenges further forces real operators to respond in time, raising forgery cost above expected reward. This model fits agent once0004's threat model.
